verified_algorithm_differences.official: core.py:690-749 normalizes with float32 epsilon, rounds posterior*65535 to uint16, uses quantized priors/posteriors in winner/volume, zeros labels outside workingMask. hippocampus.py:177-190 retains direct largest foreground connected component and nearest resamples native labels.
verified_algorithm_differences.FNIT: CPU native final posterior/priors are Double probability tensors; hippo_amygdala.py:211-259 uses a closing-assisted component selection intersected with original foreground, adds native coarse support dilation2, and sums unquantized posterior for soft volume.
verified_algorithm_differences.conclusion: Confirmed quantization, component and native-support semantics differ. Closing creates no new labeled voxels; retained/input counts are saved. Their separate causal share needs bounded saved-state comparison, not another full fit.
